items.name: Codex CLI
items.versionCommand: for pkg in "$HOME/.local/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex/package.json" "$(npm root -g 2>/dev/null)/@openai/codex/package.json"; do if [ -f "$pkg" ]; then node -p "require('$pkg').version" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; fi; done; codex --version 2>/dev/null | head -1
items.checkCommand: installed=''; for pkg in "$HOME/.local/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex/package.json" "$(npm root -g 2>/dev/null)/@openai/codex/package.json"; do if [ -f "$pkg" ]; then installed=$(node -p "require('$pkg').version" 2>/dev/null); break; fi; done; latest=$(npm view @openai/codex version 2>/dev/null); if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! codex --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo BROKEN; [ -n "$latest" ] && echo "latest: $latest"; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$installed" ] && [ -n "$latest" ] && [ "$installed" != "$latest" ]; then echo UPDATE; echo "latest: $latest"; elif [ -n "$installed" ]; then echo OK; else (npm outdated -g @openai/codex 2>/dev/null | grep -q codex && echo UPDATE) || echo OK; fi
items.updateCommand: npm install -g @openai/codex@latest 2>/dev/null || npm install -g @openai/codex@latest --prefix "$HOME/.local" 2>/dev/null || brew upgrade codex 2>/dev/null || echo 'Reinstall: npm install -g @openai/codex@latest'

items.name: OpenCode
items.checkCommand: current=$(opencode --version 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//'); if brew list opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew outdated opencode 2>/dev/null | grep -q opencode && echo UPDATE || echo OK; elif npm list -g opencode-ai --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -q opencode-ai; then npm outdated -g opencode-ai 2>/dev/null | grep -q opencode-ai && echo UPDATE || echo OK; else latest=$(curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 5 https://api.github.com/repos/anomalyco/opencode/releases/latest 2>/dev/null | sed -nE 's/.*"tag_name": "v?([^"]+)".*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$current" ] && [ -n "$latest" ] && [ "$current" != "$latest" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current" "$latest" | sort -V | tail -1)" = "$latest" ]; then echo UPDATE; echo "latest: $latest"; else echo OK; fi; fi
items.updateCommand: opencode upgrade 2>/dev/null || npm install -g opencode-ai@latest 2>/dev/null || brew upgrade opencode

items.name: GitHub CLI

items.updateCommand: brew upgrade gh 2>/dev/null || brew install gh 2>/dev/null || echo 'Update via brew install gh or https://cli.github.com'
